_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 5% base rate on ±2+ moves over 7 days screams coil behavior, and neither brain has identified a confirmed breaker — ETF flows above 30 or VIX breaking 75 with DXY above 102 — so HOLD is the statistically honest call until a directional catalyst emerges.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly grades HOLD with medium conviction citing coil statistics and missing institutional bid; narrative leans toward a squeeze setup with high confidence but does not name a breaker either
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows reverse above 30 signaling institutional return
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks 75 with DXY above 102 triggering risk-off contagion breakdown
